verdict.rationale: Anytype documents custom Types as blueprints that define what an Object is, and stores metadata as Properties on Objects. It also offers Queries that assemble Objects by user-defined criteria into live Views, giving consistent typed organization and retrieval. Community users confirm Notion-style databases with relations and sets. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of tag/multi-select properties, detail on property data types and how Types enforce property schemas, and independent hands-on corroboration of property-based filtering at scale.
